strategies.name: 15m_opening_range_breakout_close_entry
strategies.entry_summary: Define the opening range using the 9:30 15-minute candle high and low, then wait for a candle to break the range and close outside it. Enter at the open of the next candle after that confirmed breakout, with a cutoff of not taking new entries after the 12:00 candle.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss at the opposite side of the opening range and target 1.5R.

strategies.name: orb_pullback_reentry_stop_order_at_range_high
strategies.entry_summary: After the initial breakout and expected pullback, place a stop order at the top of the opening range so that if price bounces back up into that level you are entered immediately, without waiting for a previous-high break confirmation.
strategies.exit_summary: Keep the stop loss at the bottom of the opening range and use a 1.5R take-profit target.

strategies.name: orb_midpoint_pullback_stop_order_entry
strategies.entry_summary: Measure the breakout from the top of the opening range, but require price to pull back deeper to the midpoint of the opening range. Enter immediately with a stop order when price reaches that midpoint, without waiting for confirmation from a broken prior high.
strategies.exit_summary: Use a stop loss below the opening range with a 1.5R target; the midpoint entry reduces stop size and can allow aiming for more, but the stated tested baseline is 1.5R.
